summary: A 50-second travel montage cut to music with no speech. It works because cuts land on every beat and the shots grow wider as the music builds.
hook: A fast three-shot sequence on the first three drum hits, ending on a wide drone reveal.

beats.label: Drum-hit opener
beats.what_happens: Three close-ups cut on drum hits, then a drone reveal.

beats.label: Journey build
beats.what_happens: Cuts every beat; speed ramps on movement.

beats.label: Wide finale
beats.what_happens: Long wide shots slow down with the music; fade to title.

style.pacing: Shots average 1.2 s and cut on every beat at about 120 BPM; slows to 3 to 4 s shots in the last 20 seconds.
style.framing: Mix of handheld close-ups and drone wides; speed ramps on motion.
style.transitions: Hard cuts on beats, two whip pans, a final fade.
style.text_and_graphics: A single location title at the end, thin white serif, fades in.
style.audio: Upbeat cinematic electronic at about 120 BPM, building energy; whooshes on whip pans.
style.look: Teal-and-orange grade, golden-hour light, high contrast.
